apps.localizedDescription:
Spotifin is a free, open-source, Spotify-style music player that connects to your existing Jellyfin library.

Synced lyrics, daily mixes, offline downloads, remote play, Chromecast and CarPlay.

Source code: https://github.com/pablopunk/spotifin

versions.localizedDescription:
## Spotifin 0.7.0 — AltStore

This release puts Spotifin on AltStore PAL for iPhone and iPad in the EU, with Downtify included, and removes the YouTube references from Downtify.

- 📱 **AltStore PAL** — Spotifin is notarized by Apple and installs from the AltStore PAL source, with automatic updates. Downtify is included. The README has an "Add to AltStore PAL" button.
- ☁️ **Downtify** — the search bar says "Search songs, artists or albums", and tapping a song opens its source page instead of YouTube Music.
- ⚙️ **CI** — every tag release now uploads the iOS build to App Store Connect and submits it for notarization.

Licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/pablopunk/spotifin/blob/v0.7.0/LICENSE).

Verify with `SHA256SUMS`. **Full changelog**: https://github.com/pablopunk/spotifin/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0
